title: D2 Survivors: a free, unofficial Diablo II survivors-like in your browser
excerpt: D2 Survivors is a free, unofficial Diablo II fan game in the survivors style: seven classes, skills that cast on their own, five acts, then Nightmare and Hell. In the browser or the desktop app, from your own D2 or D2R files.
content_html:
Diablo II's classes, skills and loot

All seven heroes, their skill trees and D2's own items, from the first drop to a unique's gold name.

A survivors-style horde

Your skills cast on their own. Walk, pick a card each level, and outlast the five acts, then Nightmare and Hell.

Your own Diablo II or D2R

Point it at your install once and it plays from your files, in the browser or the desktop app.

From the runs

The latest build

Your own files

D2 Survivors runs on your own Diablo II or Diablo II: Resurrected. The browser or the desktop app reads your install once and keeps what it needs. Your saves come with you.

Set up your files

Questions

What is D2 Survivors?

A survivors-like in Diablo II's world. Pick a hero and walk: your skills cast on their own while the hordes come. Seven classes, D2's skills and items, five acts, then Nightmare and Hell.

Is it free?

Yes. No ads, no purchases, nothing locked.

Do I need Diablo II? Which versions work?

Yes, your own copy: classic Diablo II with Lord of Destruction (patch 1.14), or Diablo II: Resurrected. The game reads its art and sound from your install.

Does it upload my game files?

No. They're read on your computer and stay there, in your browser's storage or the app's folder. Nothing is sent.

D2 Survivors는 무엇인가요?

디아블로 II의 세계에서 펼쳐지는 서바이버라이크입니다. 영웅을 고르고 걸으면 몰려오는 무리 속에서 기술이 저절로 시전됩니다. 일곱 직업, 디아블로 II의 기술과 아이템, 다섯 막, 그리고 악몽과 지옥.

무료인가요?

네. 광고도, 결제도, 잠긴 콘텐츠도 없습니다.

디아블로 II가 필요한가요? 어떤 버전이 되나요?

네, 직접 가진 게임이 필요합니다. 디아블로 II와 파괴의 군주(1.14 패치) 또는 디아블로 II: 레저렉션. 그래픽과 사운드를 설치된 게임에서 읽어 옵니다.

내 게임 파일이 업로드되나요?

아니요. 파일은 내 컴퓨터에서 읽히고 브라우저 저장소나 앱 폴더에 그대로 남습니다. 어디에도 전송되지 않습니다.
